An '''automated probe vessel''' was dispatched to catalog the flora of several uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but it later turned up derelict in the [[Shadola sector/Legends|Shadola sector]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Flora of the Outer Rim}}</ref>
